title: After a 4.5.x upgrade to a non-default IVG Schema, Graph_KG.ledger_revisions keeps the tenant's messages, sources, correlation ids and idempotency keys, which redaction never clears
intended: specs/256-ledger-tenant-redaction/spec.md:142-143 (SC-001: after erase and redaction 'every Graph_KG.ledger_* row finds none of the tenant's ids or values'); spec.md:120-121 (FR-004, Decision 2: a revision's free text is cleared); FR-008 reach statement; docs/adr/0013-redaction-removes-content-from-history.md:47.
observed: Live (run fc1306-legacy-ledger-rows, scratch namespace IVG262FC1306): the pinned fixture's own functions (scripts/fixtures/build_release_namespace.build('v4.5.1', ..., schema_prefix='RAG'), run_ledger_commits) plus v4.5.1's public engine.ledger.commit built a 4.5.1 namespace whose Graph_KG.ledger_revisions held 7 revisions: tenant r114 (seqs 2, 3, 4, 6; seqs 4 and 6 with message, source, correlation_id and idempotency_key) and tenant o114 (seqs 5, 7). The pin's initialize_schema(schema_prefix='RAG') copied them (ledger_history_copied {ledger_revisions: 7, ledger_stats: 1}); verify() equal. The pin's delete_nodes_by_prefix('r114:') removed 3 nodes and ledger.redact(None, prefix='r114', separator=':') completed: revisions [2, 3, 4, 6], 11 records tombstoned, metadata_cleared 4, idempotency_keys_removed 2; verify() equal. Afterwards ^IVG.Ledger and RAG.ledger_revisions hold none of r114's strings, but Graph_KG.ledger_revisions (still projected by v4.5.1's Graph.KG.LedgerRevision after the upgrade) keeps seqs 2 and 3's messages and seqs 4 and 6's message, source, correlation_id and idempotency_key verbatim (4 rows hit by SC-001's 'every Graph_KG.ledger_* row' scan), and ^Graph.KG.LedgerRevisionD holds the same values (what the documented step-4 DROP ... %NODELDATA would leave). The receipt reported metadata_cleared 4 and its out_of_reach names only exports, journals and backups. Tenant o114's rows are unchanged. Source cause as before: copy_ledger_history copies and leaves the Graph_KG rows (iris_vector_graph/_engine/legacy.py:606-646, ':613'); ClearRevision's SQL is rewritten to the IVG Schema's table (iris_src/src/Graph/KG/LedgerRedact.cls:351-376; class_deploy.py:109-119).
remedy: On redaction, also clear (or report) rows of a legacy Graph_KG.ledger_revisions (and ^Graph.KG.LedgerRevisionD) when the IVG Schema is not Graph_KG; or have the upgrade move rather than copy the rows (delete or %NODELDATA plus kill of the legacy storage after the copy is verified); and name any remaining legacy copy in the receipt.
notes: Reproduced live 2026-11-14 01:52 UTC by lane fc1306 under tools/locks.sh iris, in a new scratch namespace IVG262FC1306 (/usr/irissys/mgr/ivg262fc1306/, recorded in incidents/NAMESPACES.md, left intact). The pinned fixture compiled v4.5.1's classes there (its own code, as tests/e2e/test_460_upgrade_ledger_history_e2e.py::upg does); nothing else was compiled besides the pin's own initialize_schema (66 classes, 3 MCP classes skipped: %AI absent on Community; not a dependency of this probe). The probe adds two tenants' metadata-bearing changesets through v4.5.1's public ledger API (fc1306/ledger451_child.py) because the fixture's own two changesets carry messages only. Side observation, not part of this finding: the actor value ('r114', the fixture's) stays in both schemas' ActorIdx; actor is outside FR-004's cleared fields by design. Probe: experiment/playbook-completion/fc1306/probe.py; raw result $RUN_DIR/fc1306/probe.json. Attribution (operator clarification O-1, incidents/O-1-FIXTURES.md, o1-fixture-inventory): the probe's namespace IVG262FC1306 holds the pin's classes deployed by the pin's own initialize_schema(schema_prefix='RAG') and residue of the unchanged v4.5.1 release that the pinned fixture scripts/fixtures/build_release_namespace.build built there (8 v4.5.1-only classes and v4.5.1's Graph.KG.LedgerRevision/LedgerStats); that residue is the upgrade test's intended precondition. The defect is in the pin's upgrade and redaction code. Setup authorized under O-1.
